summary: The gentilic adjective for people of Ziph, the Judean place where David hid.

senses.definition: The Ziphites report David's hiding place to Saul.

note: The corpus has no accepted זיף root key, so this separate homograph entry retains the BDB bridge root זיד while its sense is the Ziph place-name and must not be read as the presumptuousness root.
